title: Legal information clinic bookings
bodyMd:
A booking is marked attended only when the booked individual arrives. The table counts appointments, not unique people.

| Category | Booked appointments | Attended appointments |
|---|---:|---:|
| Monday | 50 | 35 |
| Wednesday | 70 | 56 |
| Friday | 80 | 68 |
